findings.evidence: Regularity.lean:70-72 has section variables `{ℓ : ℕ∞} {J : ContMDiffAlmostComplexStructureFamily I M 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) X ℓ}`. Regularity.lean:159 reads `theorem contMDiff (h : IsWeakPseudoholomorphic J ν p u) (hp : 2 < p) : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) I ℓ u`, with no hypothesis on `ℓ`.
findings.fix: Restore `refine ⟨σ, v, hσ, hvJ, hvJ.contMDiff hp, ?_, fun x ↦ (hchart x).2⟩`. With `I = 𝓘(ℝ, V)` and `M = V` it now gives `ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) 𝓘(ℝ, V) ℓ v`. Drop the chart readout.
findings.issue: The limit's `C^ℓ` regularity is re-derived by hand: `rw [contMDiffAt_iff_source, contMDiffWithinAt_iff_contDiffWithinAt]` applied to a new chart-wise `ContDiffOn` fact. The existing lemma `IsWeakPseudoholomorphic.contMDiff` already proves this for data of class `C^ℓ`, for any `ℓ : ℕ∞` (the PR description wrongly says it needs smooth data).

findings.evidence: Once line 430 uses `hvJ.contMDiff hp`, nothing else uses these conjuncts: `exists_strictMono_forall_tendsto` discards the new `ContDiffOn` conjunct with `-`, and its only other use is the regularity branch.
findings.fix: Remove both conjuncts and the `contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn` branch. Restore the original `obtain` patterns (`⟨ψ', hψ', w, -, hw⟩` and similar) and the `(hchart x).1` / `(hchart x).2` projections.
findings.issue: The new `ContDiffOn ℝ ℓ (v ∘ (chartAt ℂ x).symm) (chartAt ℂ x).target` conjunct of `tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_chartAt_of_tendsto` and its `contDiffOn_of_locally_contDiffOn` branch exist only to feed the hand-rolled regularity proof. So does the new `ContDiffOn ℝ ℓ w (ball z₀ r)` conjunct of `exists_ball_forall_exists_subseq` (line 190). Both duplicate what `IsWeakPseudoholomorphic.contMDiff` gives.

summary: The surface theorem re-proves `C^ℓ` regularity of the limit through new chart-wise `ContDiffOn` conjuncts, but `TauCeti.IsWeakPseudoholomorphic.contMDiff` already gives `ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, ℂ) I ℓ` for any `ℓ : ℕ∞`. The new planar dispatcher is fine: it only combines the finite and smooth planar theorems, and the surface proof uses it.
